blocks.html:
Where provided in buildings that are designated as emergency shelters, variable message signs conveying emergency-related information shall comply with Section 1111.4 of this code.
   Exception: Where equivalent information is provided in an audible manner, variable message signs are not required to comply with ICC A117.1.
